programs.source:
events = []
class Text(str):
    def __contains__(self, other):
        events.append(other)
        return False
text = Text('abc')
needle = Text('a')
assert (needle in text) is False
assert str.__contains__(text, needle) is True
assert len(events) == 1
assert events[0] is needle
